page_title: STU 3-3 HEI | Stuttgart v Heidenheim 31/03/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.

90+8' 3 - 3 A good lofted pass from Maximilian Mittelstadt finds Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) on the edge of the area. He collects the ball and rips in a wonderful shot which ends up in the bottom left corner. The score is now 3:3.
90+7' Frank Schmidt isn't happy on the touchline after referee Felix Zwayer shows him a yellow card.
90+6' Nikola Dovedan (Heidenheim) makes an ugly tackle on his opponent and is sent off by the referee!
90+5' The resulting corner from Angelo Stiller (VfB Stuttgart) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
90+3' Waldemar Anton (VfB Stuttgart) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.

90+2' Serhou Guirassy (VfB Stuttgart) finds himself in a promising position after receiving an excellent pass into the box, but one of the defenders produces a timely intervention to avert the threat. The ball has crossed the sideline. Stuttgart are taking a throw-in.
90' We will have 6 min. of added time.
90' The referee signals a substitution. Lennard Maloney (Heidenheim) is brought on as a substitute for Jan-Niklas Beste.
90' Atakan Karazor (VfB Stuttgart) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Felix Zwayer who sees an offensive foul.
88' Substitution. Josha Vagnoman makes way for Woo-Yeong Jeong (VfB Stuttgart).
88' Sebastian Hoeness has decided to make a change. Pascal Stenzel (VfB Stuttgart) replaces Hiroki Ito.
88' Close! Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) picks up the ball in space and from inside the penalty area sends a shot inches wide of the right post.

85' 2 - 3 It's a goal! Tim Kleindienst (Heidenheim) makes it 2:3. He jumped highest to connect with a perfect cross from Eren Dinkci and planted his close-range header into the middle of the goal. Alexander Nubel was helpless.
84' Omar Haktab Traore will be replaced by Marnon Busch (Heidenheim).
84' 2 - 2 Spectacular goal! Tim Kleindienst (Heidenheim) brilliantly darts into the box to latch on to a cross and buries the ball into the bottom right corner, leaving the goalkeeper stunned!
83' Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) forces a pass into the box, but Kevin Muller is alert and does a great job to rob him of the ball.
82' The foul by Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) was seen by Felix Zwayer who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
81' Maximilian Mittelstadt (VfB Stuttgart) pounces on a pass inside the box but flashes his shot just over the bar. That was a great chance!
77' The corner from Jan-Niklas Beste (Heidenheim) is cleared away by the defence.

77' A lofted cross from Omar Haktab Traore (Heidenheim) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area. The ball goes behind for a corner. Heidenheim will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
77' Eren Dinkci (Heidenheim) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
76' Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) wins the ball from the corner kick and strikes. The effort lacks accuracy and goes miles wide of the left post.
75' Angelo Stiller (VfB Stuttgart) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.
74' Silas (VfB Stuttgart) expertly controls a neat clever pass on the edge of the penalty area, but his effort smashes against the right post! What a shot that was!
72' Jan-Niklas Beste (Heidenheim) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.

72' Jan-Niklas Beste (Heidenheim) takes the free kick from a long way out but the defender manages to get it clear. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Heidenheim.
72' Here's the change. Chris Fuhrich leaves the pitch and Silas (VfB Stuttgart) comes on as a substitute.
70' Frank Schmidt has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Nikola Dovedan (Heidenheim) replacing Marvin Pieringer.
70' Substitution. Norman Theuerkauf is replaced by Kevin Sessa (Heidenheim).
69' The corner kick from Angelo Stiller (VfB Stuttgart) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.
69' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart). Stuttgart force a corner. They send men into the box.
68' Sebastian Hoeness prepares a substitution. Mahmoud Dahoud is replaced by Atakan Karazor (VfB Stuttgart).
67' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Jamie Leweling (VfB Stuttgart) is coming onto the pitch as Enzo Millot cannot continue after picking up an injury.
66' Jan-Niklas Beste (Heidenheim) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.

62' This is really unlucky! Alexander Nubel (VfB Stuttgart) attempted to clear the ball away after the opposition’s corner kick into the box, but instead miskicked the clearance and put it into his own net, specifically low into the middle of the net. He won't enjoy watching the highlights later.
61' There's an opportunity for Jan-Niklas Beste (Heidenheim) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.

61' What a great touch by Jan-Niklas Beste (Heidenheim) as he controls a fine pass into the box and takes a shot to the bottom left corner, but an opposing player makes a clearance. Great defending. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Heidenheim will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
59' Benedikt Gimber (Heidenheim) wins the ball from the corner kick and strikes. The effort lacks accuracy and goes miles wide of the left post.
58' Jan-Niklas Beste (Heidenheim) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
58' Marvin Pieringer (Heidenheim) sends a sweet pass into the penalty area, but one of the defenders averts the danger. The ball goes out of play and Heidenheim have been awarded a corner kick.
58' Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and shoots. His poorly placed shot flies well wide of the right post.
55' Neat link-up play between Serhou Guirassy (VfB Stuttgart) and Enzo Millot, but Kevin Muller reads the game well and the move breaks down.

53' 2 - 0 Goal Angelo Stiller (VfB Stuttgart)! Angelo Stiller (VfB Stuttgart) was put through by Deniz Undav and he showed brilliant composure inside the box to bury the ball into the back of the net. 2:0.
50' The game is interrupted. Benedikt Gimber (Heidenheim) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
50' Waldemar Anton (VfB Stuttgart) fails to find a teammate across the pitch with a long ball.
49' Wonderful movement by Stuttgart. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
47' Jan-Niklas Beste (Heidenheim) attempts to send a low pass into the box from the edge of the penalty area, but the opposition's defence knocks the ball to safety.
47' The referee blows his whistle as Maximilian Mittelstadt (VfB Stuttgart) was too aggressive in his challenge.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+5' Felix Zwayer has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+3' Eren Dinkci (Heidenheim) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
45+2' Serhou Guirassy (VfB Stuttgart) tries to find Deniz Undav, but he puts too much power on the pass. The ball goes out of play and Heidenheim will have a goal kick.

45+2' Stuttgart slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
45' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
41' 1 - 0 Goal - 1:0! Serhou Guirassy (VfB Stuttgart) receives a precise pass inside the box from Angelo Stiller and he beats the goalkeeper with a neat finish into the bottom right corner.
39' Kevin Muller pulls off a great save to deny Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick shot to the left side of the goal.
39' Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Heidenheim.
37' The cross into the penalty area from Maximilian Mittelstadt (VfB Stuttgart) needed to be more accurate in order to create a goal-scoring opportunity for his team.
34' Felix Zwayer blows his whistle as Marvin Pieringer (Heidenheim) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
33' Josha Vagnoman (VfB Stuttgart) finds space on the edge of the box, but his wild shot goes high over the bar.
32' The ratio of the ball possession is 69:31.
28' Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart) takes the corner which is cleared.

28' Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) chips a pass over the line of defenders to get the ball to Serhou Guirassy, but his attempt is intercepted and cleared. The linesman makes the right call and Stuttgart will have a corner.
26' Jan-Niklas Beste (Heidenheim) will take the corner.

26' What a great touch by Tim Kleindienst (Heidenheim) as he controls a fine pass into the box and takes a shot to the bottom left corner, but an opposing player makes a clearance. Great defending. Now Heidenheim have a corner.
23' Jonas Fohrenbach (Heidenheim) plays a terrific long ball forward to Tim Kleindienst, but he can't beat his man and the move breaks down.
22' Waldemar Anton (VfB Stuttgart) unleashes a cannonball of a shot from the edge of the area, but it zips narrowly wide of the left post.
21' Stuttgart have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
19' Jan-Niklas Beste (Heidenheim) will take a corner kick.

17' What a save from Kevin Muller! Serhou Guirassy (VfB Stuttgart) jumps high to meet a cross and glances a promising header from close range towards the roof of the net, but the goalkeeper pulls off a brilliant save to keep it out.
14' Serhou Guirassy (VfB Stuttgart) wins the ball from the corner kick and strikes. The effort lacks accuracy and goes miles wide of the left post.
14' Corner kick. Stuttgart will have an opportunity.

14' Serhou Guirassy (VfB Stuttgart) is the first to arrive to a rebound inside the penalty area and unleashes a quick strike towards the middle of the target that beats the keeper. One of the defenders, however, makes a goal-line clearance.
12' Eren Dinkci (Heidenheim) sends a long ball in, but Alexander Nubel comfortably gathers the ball.
10' The goal by Stuttgart is DISALLOWED on the advice of the video assistant referee due to an offside.
9' The Stuttgart players halt their celebrations as referee Felix Zwayer makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
8' Serhou Guirassy (VfB Stuttgart) breaks through before collecting a brilliant pass and producing a precise strike to beat the goalkeeper. The ball went into the bottom left corner.
7' Jan-Niklas Beste (Heidenheim) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
5' Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Kevin Muller intercepts the ball.
2' Stuttgart seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
